9000:
hnsdiag <command> [options ...]

   list <object> [id_1 id_2 ... id_n]
     Lists the specified object(s). If ids are given will list the ids.

   delete <object> <id_1> [id_2 ... id_n]
     Delete the specified object(s).

   reset <object>
     Delete all instances of the object.

   get_metrics [class]
    Get metrics from a certain class of HNS API call.

   Objects (applicable only to list, delete, and reset)
     All -- includes Endpoints, Loadbalancers, Namespaces, Networks (only valid when used with list, reset)
     Endpoints
     Loadbalancers
     Namespaces
     Networks
     PortRanges (only valid with list)
     Adapters (only valid with list)
     GuestNetworkServices (only valid with list)
     Flowsteering (only valid with list)

    Classes (applicable only to get_metrics)
     all -- aggregate of all classes (default if no class given)
     network,
     network_create
     network_delete
     namespace
     namespace_create
     namespace_delete
     endpoint
     loadbalancer
     sdnroute
     service
     gns
     port
     hv
     metrics

   Flags
     -d[f][l]
          Detailed option, when used with list, dumps the primitive json of the object.
        f
          Specifying 'f' will additionally give the full json of the object.
        l
	  Specifying 'l' will additionally give the object in the latest schema version.
